title: Shared SCTST–SCT molecular qualification and reduction gates
summary: Separate same-level SAM selection and sparse scalar reconstruction from absolute molecular comparisons. Approved evidence-validation procedure; no claim of universal molecular transferability.
gates: Freeze the channel symmetry, isotope masses, native coordinates, sources and scientific identities before comparing rates
Use geometric local rotors, conditional SAMs and positive induced DVR inertia; retain degenerate groups
Select SAMs with omitted periodic energy at most 10 cm^-1 and inertia at most one percent; confirm same-level rates within two percent
Use regularized HDCPT2 occupations, qualified Wang-Landau checkpoints, explicit DVR and positive rotational convolution
Compare five-Hessian scalar rates with the same complete calculation on the original PES, with a fixed thirty-percent criterion at every declared temperature
Numerical controls must cover every temperature and change rates by less than one percent
A spectrum or partition comparison does not substitute for a complete molecular rate comparison
Experimental or independent dynamics comparisons are separate from same-level component qualification
No sign repair, reference-rate tuning, silent temperature removal or automatic acquisition of new source points
A failed or missing scalar qualification does not promote a general reconstructed-potential protocol
coordinate_policy: Automatic nonredundant internal coordinates with the lowest channel symmetry; geometric LAM separation, SAM relaxation and consistent kinetic metric.
backend_policy: Existing electronic backends and approved finite acquisitions remain upstream; this operation validates completed same-level rate evidence and launches no calculation.
